name: io.github.skyphusion-labs/postern-mcp
title: Postern
description: Email for agents: read, search and send mail as yourself on your own domain, via Postern.

environmentVariables.name: POSTERN_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Postern mailbox API origin (https; http only for localhost).

environmentVariables.name: POSTERN_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer for the read tools. Prefer a per-identity token with the read scope.

environmentVariables.name: POSTERN_SEND_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer for the send tools. When set, the send tools register.

environmentVariables.name: POSTERN_ORGANIZE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer for the organize tools (read state, flags, placement).
